text:
lucy: Hey all, Lucy joining infra. Trying to enable CMEK for a small model experiment in eu-west1 but blocked: I can't link the project to billing (403) and I don't have cryptoKey encrypter/decrypter on the service account. Who to ping?

diego: welcome Lucy! billing link is handled by ops. For CMEK you need roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the service account and the KMS key must allow the service account in its IAM. What error do you see when linking?

lucy: running:
```
gcloud beta billing projects link --billing-account=01A-BILL-EU --project=ml-expt-eu
```
returns: "PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller does not have permission to link billing account"

ops: I can open the billing ticket or do the link if you prefer. @cloud-billing-bot please create billing-link request for project=ml-expt-eu billing=01A-BILL-EU requester=lucy region=eu-west1

cloud-billing-bot: billing-ticket created id=1990012345-BILL project=ml-expt-eu billing=01A-BILL-EU requester=lucy status=pending SLA=1 business day

lucy: thanks. For the KMS role, when I try to add the IAM binding I get: "gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding my-project --member=serviceAccount:sa@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" -> Error: Permission denied.

security-bot: Note: KMS key access has extra approval for prod keys. For dev experiments we can grant a temporary scoped binding if you provide key alias and service account. Please file KMS-grant request with key=projects/infra/locations/eu-west1/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/infra-artifacts-eu principal=serviceAccount:sa@ml-expt-eu.iam.gserviceaccount.com duration=7d justification="CI pulls for model weights" owner=lucy@redwood.com

diego: once billing link is done I can create the project-level binding for the SA (if ops gives me Project IAM Admin rights). Also confirm: do you need CMEK for disks only or also for GCS object encryption?

lucy: disks only for now. I'll file the KMS request. If billing link is quick I can enable CMEK and try a single VM create. Thanks! :rocket:
